# Migration failure if metadata lacks table definition

The upgrade accesses Base.metadata.tables["llm_cache"] directly; if the table definition is not present in Base.metadata.tables this will raise a KeyError and cause the migration to fail.

**Anchored to:**

- `alembic/versions/0002_llm_cache.py` — `alembic.versions.0002_llm_cache.upgrade`
